Remark
[Cylinder shrinkers (Remark 27.37)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0043 1. ch27:27.37\group Volume growth

The products $(\mathcal N^k,h)\times \mathbb R^{n-k}$ with $\Rc _h=h/2$ have $R=k/2$ and volume growth of order $(1+r)^{n-k}$.
